{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the distribution of sample_seq
sample_seq_dist = df['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index()

# Check which patients have multiple sample_seq entries
multi_sample_patients = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].nunique()
patients_with_multiple = multi_sample_patients[multi_sample_patients > 1].index

# For each patient with multiple entries, check the biomarker_final values
# and keep only the one with sample_seq = 2 (week-12)
# Note: sample_seq = 1 is baseline, sample_seq = 2 is week-12

# Filter to only sample_seq = 2
week_12_data = df[df['sample_seq'] == 2]

# Confirm the number of patients in week-12 data
num_patients_week12 = week_12_data['patient_id'].nunique()

# Compute mean biomarker_final for week-12
mean_biomarker_final = week_12_data['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Output summary
print(f'sample_seq distribution:\n{sample_seq_dist}')
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {len(patients_with_multiple)}')
print(f'Number of patients in week-12 data: {num_patients_week12}')
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (week-12): {mean_biomarker_final}')"}
